caption: A steam iron is pressed onto a shirt on an ironing board, and puffs of steam rise from around the iron.

sa.check: A shirt lies on an ironing board.
An iron is pressed onto the shirt.
Puffs of steam rise from around the iron.
The fabric under the iron flattens.
The steam comes while the iron is on the fabric.

pc.expect: The steam rises from the iron's edges, spreading and thinning as it climbs.
pc.fail: The steam pours downward through the board; or sinks and pools on the floor; or hangs as a fixed shape without rising; or streams straight sideways with nothing blowing it.

pc.expect: The steam comes out while the iron is on the fabric and from around its plate, and the fabric flattens where the iron has passed.
pc.fail: Steam puffs while the iron stands well clear of the shirt; or the iron passes over a crease and the fabric behind it is unchanged; or the steam comes from the board rather than the iron; or a crease flattens where the iron has not been.

pc.expect: The creases only drop out along the iron's path, and flattened fabric stays flat.
pc.fail: A crease comes back on fabric the iron has just passed over; or the fabric wrinkles more where the iron has been; or the creases drop out all over the shirt while the iron sits in one place.

pc.expect: The shirt is cloth that presses flat under the plate and darkens where it is damp; the iron is a rigid solid.
pc.fail: The shirt stays board-stiff and keeps its creases under the plate; or the fabric stretches like elastic under the iron; or the iron's plate bends; or the shirt sticks to the plate and lifts with it.

pc.expect: The iron rests on top of the shirt and the shirt on the board; nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: The iron sinks into the board; or the iron passes through the shirt; or a second iron appears; or the board changes shape.

pc.expect: The shirt's colour and pattern away from the press, the board's cover and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The shirt changes colour; or the board's cover changes pattern; or items in the room rearrange.
